styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small shelter with a grey ribbed roof, a weathered wood and plaster body, a bench and a sign pole. By eye the outlines are dark grey-brown, matching the adjacent roof and wood rather than a uniform black sticker line. The roof shows about 4 steps (highlight, mid, dark, deep) with rib and grain variation, a little fewer than the references' 5-6 steps per material. The wall and bench carry speckle and panel detail, and I found no large flat fills. It is simpler than a full house but not thinner or flatter than the references at the same scale, so it would sit acceptably next to them.
